# Sawtooth Thrift

Official website: https://sawtooththrift.com/

Sawtooth Thrift is a Twin Falls, Idaho thrift and vintage shop with curated one-of-one finds and weekly product drops. The current website offers nationwide shipping and Stripe checkout.

## Official business facts
- Location: Twin Falls, Idaho
- Phone: +1 208-280-8976
- Website: https://sawtooththrift.com/
- New drops: weekly
- Orders: current website states that orders ship on Saturdays

## Important pages
- Storefront: https://sawtooththrift.com/
- Cart: https://sawtooththrift.com/cart.html

Use the official website and product pages as the source of truth for current inventory, item condition, pricing, availability, shipping and checkout information.
